class.name: BehaviorTree
class.brief_description: Small deterministic behavior-tree runtime with memory and reactive composites, conditions and actions.
class.description: BehaviorTree evaluates a nested Dictionary description. Each BehaviorTree instance owns its execution memory and blackboard, so separate agents should instantiate separate trees. The runtime supports [code]sequence[/code], [code]selector[/code], [code]reactive_sequence[/code], [code]reactive_selector[/code], [code]inverter[/code], [code]condition[/code], [code]set[/code], and [code]wait[/code]. Memory composites resume their running child; reactive composites restart evaluation at their first child on every tick to respond to changed priorities or conditions. Switching away from a running child cancels its saved execution state (including nested waits), but does not roll back blackboard writes. It does not yet contain a visual graph editor, GDScript callback tasks or an editor inspector.

method.name: set_tree
method.description: Validates and deep-copies a nested node Dictionary. Returns false without replacing the previous tree on malformed data. A sequence, selector, reactive_sequence or reactive_selector has a non-empty [code]children[/code] Array, an inverter has one [code]child[/code], condition uses [code]key[/code] and [code]equals[/code], set uses [code]key[/code] and [code]value[/code], and wait uses a nonnegative [code]ticks[/code] integer.

method.name: get_tree
method.description: Returns a deep copy of the current tree definition.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances the tree by one logical tick and returns FAILURE, SUCCESS or RUNNING. Wait nodes count ticks, not elapsed wall-clock time.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears execution memory without modifying the blackboard.

method.name: set_blackboard_value
method.description: Sets a key in this instance's blackboard.

method.name: get_blackboard_value
method.description: Returns the stored value or the specified fallback.

method.name: has_blackboard_value
method.description: Returns whether the blackboard contains the specified key.
